diesel_break_rule: Exclude features whose current/prior-year quarter observations span pre/post survey designs; exclude those rows from both diesel training and scoring. No inferred bridge adjustment.
regimes: Modern 2021 onward only for combinations; older tests stay separate in previous archive
peer_selection: Latest reported overlapping fiscal period, public strictly before target quarter-end; preserve unexpected margin and peer basis; never copy absolute peer margin
all_blend_weights: Fixed equal weights, require every component; no missing-component reweighting
comparison: Production and individual challengers on identical rows; fixed existing gate, recent eight and remove-largest-benefit sensitivity
tuning: No subset search, no optimized blend weights, no automatic promotion; history already examined
